text:
priya: Hey team — multiple customers reporting their Console hourly usage hasn't updated for ~5 hours (last row at 02:00Z). Affected tenants: tenant_452, tenant_acme, tenant-omega. Can someone triage?

alex: I see a sharp consumer lag on the hourly-rollup consumer group. Consumer lag ~580k messages since ~01:50Z. Pasting latest consumer-state: `consumer_group=hourly-rollup, partition=12, lag=580123`

sre-bot: Alert: Kafka consumer group `hourly-rollup` lag > 500k (triggered 3301112300). Topic: `ingest.hourly.events`.

marco: I pulled the rollup worker logs, getting repeated SQL deadlock errors when writing to `hourly_rollups` table. Sample: ```ERROR: deadlock detected while trying to acquire lock; process 23456 waits for ShareLock on transaction 7890```

tanya: Any recent schema or index changes on that table?

alex: There was a migration (PR #8123) that added a partial index for `tenant_id, hour_ts` which started rolling out at 01:45Z. I think PG is doing index build/cleanup — I see `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` activity around that time.

marco: Confirmed. PG activity shows an index rebuild and a bloat cleanup autovacuum job overlapping. Writes are getting serialized -> consumers retry -> backlog grows.

priya: Customers asking for ETA. Can we do a targeted mitigation (pause index job / restart worker / run backfill)?

alex: Short term: we can throttle the rollup workers (reduce concurrency) so writes are slower but avoid deadlocks. Longer short-term: restart the rollup consumer pods one at a time to pick up fresh DB connections after the schema change.

data-platform: Suggested immediate action: (1) scale down `hourly-rollup` parallelism to 2, (2) restart one pod of `rollup-consumer-0`, wait 60s, then restart others, (3) monitor consumer lag.

marco: I kicked off a single-pod restart and reduced parallelism in k8s. Logs show workers resumed but some rows 01:50–02:10 still missing. We'll need a backfill for that window.

priya: OK please run a targeted backfill for tenant_452 and tenant_acme for 01:00Z–03:00Z. Ask for customer permission if we need to reingest any sensitive data.

alex: Running dry-run of backfill SQL: ```INSERT INTO hourly_rollups (tenant_id, hour_ts, usage) SELECT tenant_id, hour_bucket(ts), sum(tokens) FROM raw_events WHERE hour_bucket(ts) BETWEEN '2024-10-01T01:00:00Z' AND '2024-10-01T03:00:00Z' AND tenant_id IN ('tenant_452','tenant_acme') GROUP BY tenant_id, hour_bucket(ts) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,hour_ts) DO UPDATE SET usage = EXCLUDED.usage;```

sre-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bf-3301112450, scope=targeted, tenants=2.

marco: Backfill started. Patch: added safety `LIMIT` batch of 10k rows to avoid DB pressure. Monitoring write latency.

tanya: Please draft a short customer-facing note: cause (index build + deadlocks causing consumer retries), status (mitigation + targeted backfill), ETA (start backfill now, expect visible metrics within 20–40m for affected hours). I'll review.

priya: Drafting message now. Also opening a support ticket for each tenant with repro steps and internal incident reference INC-330111.

alex: After we finish backfill, we should run a quick validation query per tenant: `SELECT hour_ts, usage FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id='tenant_452' AND hour_ts >= '2024-10-01T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY hour_ts;` compare against aggregated raw_events counts.

marco: Backfill progress: 8/12 batches done. Consumer lag dropped from 580k -> 120k.

sre-bot: Consumer lag now 120345 (3301113300).

priya: Thanks — keeping customers updated. I'll post interim note: "We're seeing delayed hourly metrics due to a schema/index operation that created temporary DB write contention. Engineers have reduced worker concurrency, restarted consumers, and are running a targeted backfill. We expect metrics to repopulate within ~30 minutes. INC-330111."

tanya: After this, we need a postmortem: action items — revert index rollout, re-evaluate concurrent index strategy, add a pre-rollout checklist (check for long-running autovacuum/index ops), and an auto-mitigation to throttle consumers on DB write errors.

priya: Noted. I'll create the postmortem doc and link customers.

marco: Backfill complete. All batches done. Verified rows for tenant_452 and tenant_acme present.

alex: Validation query shows hourly_rollups now match aggregated raw_events for the affected window. Consumer lag drained to normal.

sre-bot: Alert resolved: consumer group `hourly-rollup` lag < 10k. (3301113790)

priya: Closing loop with customers now. Thanks for quick response. :thumbsup:
